breath_speed.description: How fast the pulse dot and orb breathe. 1.0 is the default; higher is faster, lower is slower.
breath_speed.label: Breath speed

orb_swell.description: How far the desktop orb magnifies as it breathes. 0 keeps it a static size; 1.0 is the default; higher swells more.
orb_swell.label: Orb swell

pulse_glow_floor.description: How dim the bar dot gets at the low point of its breath. 0 dims to black; higher stays brighter. 0.45 is the default.
pulse_glow_floor.label: Bar dot glow floor

consent_mode.label: Tool consent gate
consent_mode.description: Approve Claude's tool calls from the desktop. Off behaves as if the gate were not installed. Learn records what Claude runs without ever blocking, so the allowlist is seeded from your real traffic. Enforce asks about anything not yet allowlisted; an unanswered prompt falls through to Claude Code's own permission flow.
